item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Saanvi's tall can filled with water. Small holes are made in the side wall at two heights. Water streams out sideways through the holes.

Saanvi asks what this shows about the pressure of the water.

options.text: Water pushes only downward on the bottom of the can.
Water also pushes on the side walls of the can.
Water streams out only because the top of the can is open to air.
Pressure acts on the side walls only at the lower hole.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.
